summary: The repaired Playwright TypeScript test file compiles and uses Playwright APIs correctly. All test cases with their IDs are present and correctly named. Await is used properly with asynchronous assertions. Selectors use role-based queries which are robust, though the product item selector relies on a data-testid attribute which is acceptable if present. The code is maintainable with constants for category names and URLs. Minor warning on assumption of data-testid attribute for products, but this is common practice.

issues.description: The selector '[data-testid="product-item"]' assumes the presence of a data-testid attribute which may not be guaranteed.
issues.recommendation: Ensure the application under test includes the data-testid attribute on product items or use a more robust selector if possible.
